ana_p: Heads up — Orion SI joint marketplace launch target next Tue. Need to lock SI co-sell intake + lead ownership rules by EOD Friday. Quick asks: ACV thresholds, region routing, and who owns post-demo handoff (renewals vs SI ops).

mike_s: ACV threshold? 50k? 100k?

jordan_int: +1 on thresholds. Proposed: ACV >= 75k -> SI-led (they get first-touch + demo); ACV < 75k -> Redwood-led with SI enablement. Also geo carve: EMEA APAC -> SI takes primary if they have field coverage.

sarah_pm: For the marketplace listing sync: who is the owner to publish co-branded assets and announcement copy? We need legal OK before public. @legal-team and @marketing will need a 48h review window.

ana_p: typo — meant ana_p. (ignore)

ana_p: (sorry, brain fart)

ana_p: Updated matrix below, quick CSV for upload to intake queue: 

```
lead_id,company,estimated_acv,region,initial_owner,handoff_condition
1001,Acme Corp,120000,NA,SI,afterPOC
1002,BlueSky,40000,EMEA,Redwood,SI_support
1003,GreenGrid,80000,APAC,SI,afterPOC
```

jordan_int: We also need a short SLA: SI has 5 business days to respond to assigned demo requests before it auto-requeues to Redwood SDR pool. Also require the SI to record demo notes in the intake ticket.

partner-bot: marketplace-intake created by ana_p for joint-launch: https://app.redwood/marketplace/intake/2211112222 :eyes:

mike_s: I can run the triage session Fri 10am PT to walk through the CSV and SLA. I'll invite salesops + SI ops.

sarah_pm: I'll draft the announcement timeline and tag marketing + legal. For press kit: request SI logo + short partner blurb by Thu EOD.

ana_p: again - ana_p sorry. Two things: 1) please add a fallback policy: if SI declines within 48h we auto-assign back to Redwood to avoid lead rot. 2) who signs NDAs for joint demos? Legal or SI?

jordan_int: SI signs their own NDAs with prospects but Redwood legal needs to approve the co-demo script and any data handling notes. We'll surface NDA templates in the intake ticket.

ana_p: Perfect. Next steps I captured: 
- mike_s run triage Fri 10am PT (invite: salesops, si-ops, marketing)
- jordan_int attach NDA template & enable intake auto-reroute rules
- sarah_pm draft announcement timeline + ask SI for logos by Thu EOD
- legal-team to review co-demo script (48h)

ana_p: If no objections, I'll lock the rules and publish intake mapping Friday after the triage. :thumbsup:

mike_s: +1

jordan_int: +1

partner-bot: Reminder scheduled: triage session Fri 10:00 PT (invites sent).
